purpose: Reconciled source purposes: [1] Define deterministic taint propagation through DWH transformations so derived data inherits all relevant source restrictions unless an explicit authorized sanitization/declassification rule removes or transforms them. [2] Define formal propagation of source classification/taint metadata through DWH transformations so derived data cannot silently become less restricted than its governed inputs.

owns: DWH Taint and Classification Propagation semantics

value.aggregation_rule: Aggregation does not automatically clear taint merely because individual values are no longer directly visible.
value.authorization_rule: Classification influences governance inputs but is not itself an AccessCore authorization decision.
value.classification_rule: Input data may carry explicit classification/taint labels according to owning schema/policy.
value.default_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Relevant taint propagates monotonically from inputs to outputs. [2] Absent an explicit safe declassification rule, derived output must not be less restrictive than the most restrictive contributing input according to the active lattice/policy.
value.identity_rule: Classification metadata is attached to exact data/schema/field lineage refs.
value.join_rule: Multi-source derivation uses an explicit classification join/merge rule.
value.multi_input_rule: For joins/compositions, output receives the union/composition of applicable input taint states.
value.no_guess_rule: Runtime never guesses that data is safe because a transformation name appears benign.
value.operation_rule: Transformation operation declares any taint-specific propagation semantics beyond the default monotonic rule.
value.projection_rule: Selecting a field retains taint derived from that field and any transformation dependencies.
value.propagation_rule: Derived output classification is computed from explicit propagation rules over all contributing inputs.
value.remote_rule: Remote transport preserves taint metadata required by the governed receiving policy.
value.unknown_rule: Unknown/unclassified governed input does not silently downgrade output classification.

invariants.rule: DWH lineage and taint state remain explicit, monotonic unless an authorized transformation says otherwise, and traceable to source evidence.
Derived DWH data retains explicit source lineage, transformation provenance and applicable classification/taint state; transformations never silently erase origin or governance metadata.

references.purpose: Propagation operates on explicit taint metadata.
Classification remains an input to governed policy, not authorization itself.
